name: ProgressBar
summary: Communicates task completion or indeterminate progress.

useWhen: Showing how far a task has got, or that it is waiting, such as an upload
avoidWhen: Showing a static measurement; use Meter
Showing progress in a compact space; use ProgressCircle

obligations: Expose value and label when determinate

behavior: Determinate values are clamped to the range
Omitted value produces an indeterminate progressbar
Determinate completion is exposed when value reaches or exceeds maxValue
A value of 0 is determinate: it shows 0% and an empty fill.
The visible value text is Loading while indeterminate, and the percent of the range with a % sign otherwise.
The percent is not rounded: a value of 33.3333 shows 33.3333%.
The text Loading is built in and is not localized.
ProgressBar holds no task or result state: it renders the value it is given.
accessibility: Expose progressbar role and value semantics without continuous motion
